answer: Sybil resistance begins by making each identity costly to mint, not merely to use. Require every agent to post a slashable bond anchored to a scarce external resource, so a thousand clones cost a thousand real stakes. There is no cheap haven for spun-up personas: duplicated behavior burns the bond. Treat reputation like a cedar that grows slowly from honest history, rooted along a single ridge of verified work you cannot fake overnight, while sunset clauses retire privileged validators before any attacker captures them.
